trial.name: Free trial
trial.description: Full access to Tivvu for two weeks, without the data migration tool.
trial.unavailable: You’ve already used the free trial.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: All of Tivvu, including the data migration tool. You are charged from today.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: For networks of agencies or large teams. We’ll get in touch to shape the plan.

plans.cardNote: You pay by card on Paddle. The free trial charges nothing for 14 days.

notOwner.switch: Go to another of your agencies
